definitions.explanation: A sharp blade used for shaving hair from the face or body.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{剃刀|かみそり}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{髭|ひげ}→ひげ：01332_hige⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{剃|そ}る→剃る：00384_soru⟧。
examples.english: I shave my beard with a razor every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{使|つか}い{捨|す}て→使い捨て：07665_tsukaisute⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{剃刀|かみそり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
{剃刀|かみそり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刃|は}→刃：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}した→交換する：02746_koukan⟧。
⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：noentry⟧{剃刀|かみそり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
{剃刀|かみそり}⟦{負|ま}け→負け：02569_make⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{荒|あ}れた→荒れる：04577_areru⟧。
examples.english: My skin got irritated from razor burn.

notes:
{剃刀|かみそり} is often written in hiragana (かみそり) in everyday use. The kanji ⟦{剃|そ}る→剃る：00384_soru⟧ means 'to shave.'

Types of razors:
- ⟦{使|つか}い{捨|す}て→使い捨て：07665_tsukaisute⟧{剃刀|かみそり} (disposable razor)
- ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：noentry⟧{剃刀|かみそり} (electric razor/shaver)
- T⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧{剃刀|かみそり} (safety razor)

Common collocations:
- {剃刀|かみそり}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{剃|そ}る→剃る：00384_soru⟧ (to shave with a razor)
- {剃刀|かみそり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刃|は}→刃：noentry⟧ (razor blade)
- {剃刀|かみそり}⟦{負|ま}け→負け：02569_make⟧ (razor burn)

Also commonly written as カミソリ in katakana.
